Miami Spine and Performance is an Integrative Chiropractic clinic based in Hollywood, FL. Our mission is not only to help patients in our clinic get out of pain and move better, but also to educate the health, fitness and wellness community on how to keep their bodies healthy and feeling great!
For any inquiries or to book an appointment with one of our physicians please call 754-231-8338 or book online at miamispineandperformance.com
